run_check_repo_quality: run the full repository quality check to verify all models are tested and documented
check_model_list: check that all model directories are included in the models init file
check_models_are_tested: check that all models defined in a module have corresponding tests in the test file
check_all_models_are_auto_configured: check that all models are registered in at least one auto mapping class
check_all_objects_are_documented: check that all public objects in the init are properly documented in doc files
